items.title: Mickey Roker interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: Mickey was interviewed by Michael Woods aboard a cruise ship

ctx.x: Drummer Mickey Roker was born in Miami in 1932. He grew up in the active jazz atmosphere of Philadelphia and jammed with Jimmy Heath, Lee Morgan and McCoy Tyner. Mickey re-settled in New York in the late ‘50’s and performed with Duke Pearson, Nancy Wilson and Art Farmer, later teaming up with Joe Williams from 1961-63. Much of the ‘70’s was spent with Dizzy Gillespie, with whom he shared a love and talent for Latin music. Such musical giants as Oscar Peterson, Ray Brown and Sonny Rollins have called on Mickey to…
Mickey was interviewed by Michael Woods aboard a cruise ship in the
Good evening. We are on board the Royal Caribbean Cruise Line and we are filming a jazz archive for Hamilton College. Our guest today is Mickey Roker.
